title: Zesty Peppery German Sausage Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful German stew featuring white wine and peppery sausage, cooked to perfection in a tagine.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the German sausage to the pot, browning it on all sides.
Add the white wine to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the chicken broth, paprika, salt, and pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using, and continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
